title: UNICEDE/2 Reference
text:
UNICEDE
/2 Reference

UNICEDE
/2 information enables primary
 insurers and their treaty reinsurers to exchange aggregate sums insured, risk count, payroll
 and premium data in a format that you can import easily. 

The information is used to import aggregated exposure data into 
Touchstone Re
 (and previously into 
CATRADER
). Note there are multiple versions of this
 content, v2.10 being the most recent.
